verdict.rationale: Real-time sync across open sessions is a fair question for a collaborative project-management tool like Shortcut, so the axis applies. The pack has no evidence that teammates' edits appear live without a refresh. The closest items are off-target: integrations that update Shortcut from Git tools, Doc collaborators seeing proposed changes (a suggestion feature), and instant testing of the MCP server, a developer workflow.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can see teammates' changes reflected instantly across open sessions without refreshing
